title: Airfare of the Week: Qantas Business Class Johannesburg – Sydney from $4,435 Return
body:
Australian Frequent Flyer
Australian Frequent Flyer - Tips, Tricks and Chat for Australian Frequent Flyers
Johannesburg, South Africa. Photo: Adobe Stock.
Our newest Airfare of the Week belongs to Qantas, which has round-trip Business Class fares from Johannesburg (JNB) to Sydney (SYD) from AU$4,435.
Of course, you can earn Qantas Frequent Flyer points & status credits with this airfare. It could be useful if you travel regularly to South Africa and can nest trips. Also, it can be a decent haul of status credits.
Note that this fare price is only available departing from South Africa – if your point of origin is Australia, you’ll pay around double!
Here are the full details of this great Business Class airfare from Johannesburg to Sydney…
Sample itinerary & pricing
Screenshot from Google Flights
You can book this fare on the Qantas website. You can also add a stop in Perth on the days that Qantas is not operating the direct Johannesburg-Sydney flight for about $50 more.
This adds a few hours to the journey, but it does mean you’ll earn some extra status credits.
Note that fares and availability are subject to change. This fare may not be available by the time you read this article, and you might need to be flexible with travel dates. We recommend booking ASAP to avoid disappointment!
Travel dates & fare rules
Here are the details of this airfare:
No minimum stay requirements
Maximum stay at the destination of 12 months
One free stopover permitted in each direction, at transit points only
On-board product
Qantas Business Class on the A380 and A330s flying between Johannesburg and Australia is a modern lie-flat product, with direct aisle access at every seat.
Qantas A380 Business Class cabin. Photo: Qantas.
There is no Wi-Fi on board the A380 at this point, although there’s a good selection of entertainment options, and a lounge at the front of the upper deck.
The onboard lounge on the Qantas A380. Photo: Qantas.
If you do choose a connecting flight between Sydney and Perth, you may be on board an A330 with a similar product, or a Boeing 737/ Airbus A321XLR with recliner seats in Business Class.
Earning points & status credits with this airfare
This fare books into “I” class. As such, you could earn a nice chunk of Qantas points and status credits for this airfare.
If you fly direct between Johannesburg and Sydney, you’ll earn 11,250 Qantas points and 160 status credits each way. If you fly via Perth, you’ll earn 13,125 Qantas points and 220 status credits each way.
If you have Qantas status , you’ll also earn bonus points on top.
